description: This file defines the ExecSystemRunCommandValidator enum which includes methods for validating, normalizing, and processing shell commands and their components within a system execution context. It handles various shell wrappers, environment modifications, and inline commands.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Validates and constructs a ResolvedCommand object based on input command array and raw command string.

methods.name: allowlistEvaluationRawCommand
methods.description: Checks if the raw command is allowed based on the command's context (shell wrapper or not).

methods.name: normalizeRaw
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the raw command string and converts empty strings to nil.

methods.name: trimmedNonEmpty
methods.description: Returns the trimmed non-empty string or nil.

methods.name: allowlistEvaluationRawCommand
methods.description: Determines if the normalized raw command matches the expected shell command or is allowable.

methods.name: normalizeExecutableToken
methods.description: Converts an executable token to lowercase and removes '.exe' suffix if present.

methods.name: isEnvAssignment
methods.description: Detects if a token is an environment variable assignment.

methods.name: hasEnvInlineValuePrefix
methods.description: Checks if a token has a prefix indicating an inlined environment value.

methods.name: unwrapEnvInvocationWithMetadata
methods.description: Unwraps environment invocation commands, returning arguments and whether modifiers are used.

methods.name: unwrapShellMultiplexerInvocation
methods.description: Unwraps shell multiplexer commands like 'busybox' or 'toybox'.

methods.name: hasEnvManipulationBeforeShellWrapper
methods.description: Checks recursively if environment manipulations occur before shell wrappers.

methods.name: hasTrailingPositionalArgvAfterInlineCommand
methods.description: Determines if there are trailing arguments after inline commands in inline-capable wrappers.

methods.name: unwrapShellWrapperArgv
methods.description: Unwraps nested shell wrapper commands to get the core command arguments.

methods.name: findInlineCommandTokenMatch
methods.description: Finds a token that matches inline command flags and extracts inline command info.

methods.name: resolveInlineCommandTokenIndex
methods.description: Resolves the index of the token containing inline commands.

methods.name: combinedCommandInlineOffset
methods.description: Detects if a token combines command flag and inline command content.

methods.name: extractShellInlinePayload
methods.description: Extracts inline command payload from shell wrapper arguments.

methods.name: extractInlineCommandByFlags
methods.description: Retrieves inline command string based on command flags.

methods.name: extractCmdInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts the inline command payload from Windows 'cmd' inline commands.
